scope: Official vendor public docs and published examples only. No logins, tenant enumeration, token requests, private records, app binaries or decompilation.
principal_findings: Erecruit WebAPI is the most directly relevant historical platform lead. It is separate from Bullhorn ATS/CRM REST.
Public docs establish substantial workflow/API capabilities but do not reveal Amergis tenant configuration, current product version, data, or MaxView integration mappings.
Access programs provide legitimate test environments; current Bullhorn terms condition AI/LLM integrations and customer-data access on explicit permissions.

webhooks.status: Documented event subscriptions are polled queues, not automatic push callbacks. Create/update/delete events identify affected entity and changed properties; consumer then reads required fields. Consumption purges returned events from the queue; this GET has stateful effects. Published limits: 15 subscriptions/database, 100 events/request, seven-day event expiry.

access_conditions.summary: Published policy requires customer-specific written instruction for a provider accessing customer data and explicit Bullhorn permission for third-party AI/LLM API use. It also restricts competing uses, unauthorized model/MCP transfers, excess extraction and API/service source-code reverse engineering. Other agreements may override conflicting terms.
access_conditions.implication: Assess and obtain vendor permission before proposing a live AI connector. Public-documentation analysis is distinct from connecting an AI to the API.

access_conditions.summary: API Access Program describes an annual fee, sandbox, technical resources and 200,000 monthly calls, with overages. Sandbox access follows contract signature, security assessment and cleared invoice. Published FAQ disallows uncontracted vendor access through a customer key.
access_conditions.implication: A sandbox request is a commercial onboarding step; no registration, purchase or request was submitted.

known_documentation_caveats: Erecruit public pages disagree on legacy release boundaries and token duration; use the licensed current version specification.
Published 3.2 Erecruit capabilities are historical generic features, not evidence all are enabled at Amergis.
Do not confuse unrelated erecruit.io search results with Erecruit by Bullhorn; none were used.
Do not infer Bullhorn Recruitment Cloud/Salesforce or Automation APIs from shared Bullhorn branding.
